posts.title: Proton Drive vs Internxt (2026): Encryption, Apps, Plans and Who Each One Fits
posts.description: Proton Drive and Internxt both encrypt files on your device and publish their client code. They differ on cryptography, Linux and command-line support, storage tiers, billing model and jurisdiction. A side-by-side comparison built from each provider's own documentation.

posts.title: Claude Code Hooks: Deterministic Rules for a Non-Deterministic Agent
posts.description: Hooks are shell commands the harness runs at fixed points in an agent's loop. They matter because they are the only part of the system that always fires: a prompt asks a model to behave, a hook makes the behaviour a property of the tool.

posts.title: One Poisoned Pull Request, Two Agents: The First Agent-on-Agent Supply Chain Exploit
posts.description: A researcher turned a low-privilege bot in Google's Agent Development Kit repo into a lever against a high-privilege one. Google patched it and declined the bounty. Both positions are defensible, and that is the interesting part.
